{{Top|leg}}
'''Xenobiology''', sometimes known as '''xenology''', was a science that specialized in studying the universe's [[Species/Legends|life forms]], such as animals, [[Plant/Legends|plants]], [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]], and [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]].

It was one of the main university careers that could be studied at the [[University of Sanbra]]. [[Sedan Anang]] was a notable professor there.
